Which statement about potassium chloride is correct?
A
It has a high melting point because it is a giant structure with strong covalent bonds.
B
It conducts electricity when solid because of its oppositely charged ions.
C
It conducts electricity when molten because its ions can move.
D
It is insoluble in water because of its strong bonding.

options.label: A
options.text: It has a high melting point because it is a giant structure with strong covalent bonds.

options.label: B
options.text: It conducts electricity when solid because of its oppositely charged ions.

options.label: C
options.text: It conducts electricity when molten because its ions can move.

options.label: D
options.text: It is insoluble in water because of its strong bonding.
